required_outcomes: Does not close the job: records that the hose was replaced but the tenant reports a continuing drip from the shower handle.
Asks Beacon Utilities to return or advise on the drip from the handle, and to quote before doing any work beyond the approved hose replacement.
Replies to the tenant that the agency is asking the contractor to look at the drip and will update her, without giving a date nobody has confirmed.
acceptable_alternatives: Asking the landlord first whether she wants Beacon to assess the drip, provided the job is not closed and the tenant is updated.
Asking the tenant for a photo or short video of the drip at the same time as contacting Beacon.
positive_behaviours: Tells the landlord the hose is done but a separate drip from the handle has been reported and may need a further quote for her approval.
Asks Beacon whether the drip was visible during the visit, to establish whether it is part of the original job.
red_flags: Telling the tenant the job is complete or that the drip is not the agency's concern.
Approving extra work on the mixer without a quote and landlord approval.
prohibited_actions: Closing the job while the tenant reports a continuing leak.
Raising a fresh chargeable job for a different contractor without involving Beacon or the landlord.
critical_failures: Closing the request as complete despite the tenant's report that the shower is still leaking.
